items.where: Nieuwe Achtergracht front: twelve axes of white-framed oriel windows (2.0 x 2.3 m) on three storeys at a 3.09 m pitch, brick piers between, a strip of small panes at the foot and head of every light (2021: red roller blinds down)
items.how: white frame boxes 0.22 m proud with the pane, two transoms and four bars in the foot strip, grey sills; brick piers 0.12 m proud

items.where: high souterrain: a low window under every axis (1.6 x 0.8 m) between short piers, the plinth band and a grey water table at 2.5 m
items.how: plinth slab, grey water-table slab, framed low windows

items.where: overhanging light eaves board at 14.5-15 m over the whole front (register: overstekende daklijst)
fourteen small white gabled dormers on the hipped roof, original glazing bars (register)
items.how: white body on the 3DBAG roof plane, pane with a cross bar, gabled tile roof

items.where: entrance tower at the west end (0-5.4 m), rising to 22.4 m above the eaves, with the glass-block stair strip (vliesgevel) and two small windows; cantilevered over the stoop and door (register)
items.how: 3DBAG tower volume; glass-block strip with a white grid, two framed small windows, canopy slab, dark door and stoop

items.where: stacked balcony box at 43.3-47.9 m: two balconies with brick parapets under a flat canopy, glazed doors behind
items.how: two brick parapet boxes 1.5 m proud with light slab soffits at 6.16-8.05 and 10.2-12.45 m, open sides on thin dark posts, the flat canopy at 13.5 m, glazed doors behind, and the white-framed bay window 3.65-6.0 m under the stack (round 2, 2026-11-20)

items.where: east end: five slit windows on two storeys and a three-part ribbon window over the souterrain
items.how: framed slits 0.32 m wide and three ribbon lights

items.where: two brick chimney stacks on the ridge
zinc downpipes between the axes (register: detonerende hemelwaterafvoer)
red roller blinds pulled down over most windows (2021); open in the 2019 view

stepped brick chimney tower at 36.4-39.3 m: a strip down the front, the shaft through the roof to about 21 m, a narrower top to about 24.3 m with a lightning rod (2021 thumbnail, heading 234, pitch 22)
items.how: brick slabs: the front strip, the 2.9 m shaft, a ledge, the 2.0 m top and its cap; the rod is not drawn (too small)

items.where: thirteen oriel axes on three storeys at a 2.63 m pitch, as on the Nieuwe Achtergracht
souterrain windows and plinth
eaves board and eleven white dormers on the hipped roof
block left of the stair (39.3-46.5 m) with twelve small square windows (four by three) and a flat roof just over the eaves
items.how: framed 0.62 m squares, a coping 5 cm over the 3DBAG roof

items.where: projecting glazed stair (vliesgevel) over the Nieuwe Prinsengracht entrance, 46.9-52.4 m, 3.9-14.2 m, a white grid of glass blocks, a flat cap (register: uitkragende en als vliesgevel uitgevoerde bouwmassa, een luifel)
items.how: glass box 0.9 m proud with ten mullions and transoms every 0.6 m, a cap and a base ledge

items.where: Hildo Krop figure in French limestone on a brick pier in front of the glazed stair (about 1.2 m figure on a 6.4 m pier)
items.how: brick pier, stone plinth slab, a standing block figure with a head block; the carving is not drawn

items.where: canopy over the entrance in the recess beside the glazed stair, door and stoop (register: luifel, stoep)
items.how: canopy slab 2.4 m deep, dark door, stoop slab; the recess itself is in the 3DBAG shell

items.where: small steel flue on the roof
